q: Which plot is best for a trend over time?
tip: Time is ordered, so a line can connect the points.

q: Which plot inspects a relationship between two numeric variables?
tip: Each dot carries an x value and a y value.

q: In a boxplot, what does a dot beyond the whisker represent?
tip: Whiskers stop at 1.5 x IQR; anything beyond is plotted as a dot.

q: NovaTech's mean contract was far above the median. What does that suggest?
options: A few very large contracts pull the average up
Every customer pays about the same
answer: A few very large contracts pull the average up
tip: The mean is sensitive to extreme values, the median is not.

q: When does a pie chart make sense?
options: A few parts that add up to one whole
answer: A few parts that add up to one whole
tip: Pies show shares, so slices must sum to 100%.

q: Which chart compares values across separate categories such as regions?
tip: Bar heights are easy to compare from a shared baseline.

q: Which Matplotlib function draws the stacked area chart of revenue by product?
tip: plt.stackplot(x, y1, y2, ...) stacks each series on the previous one.

q: Which Matplotlib function displays a chart after you create it?
tip: Every snippet in this case study ends with plt.show().

q: Which Matplotlib function labels the x-axis?
tip: plt.xlabel('Month') and plt.ylabel('Revenue') name the axes.
